# Cross The Bridge

> Cross The Bridge is an AI implementation agency in Tampa Bay, Florida. We build, train, and maintain AI agents for owner-operated businesses — you get more time and more revenue without having to become a tech expert. Most clients are fully operational within 30 days.

Founded and run by Wesley Schlemmer (Founder, Cross The Bridge — Tampa Bay, FL). Background: 8 years in Bitcoin and open-source systems, now applying the same sovereignty-first approach to AI. Personal site: https://wesleyschlemmer.com/

## Services and pricing

- Discovery & AI Audit: $499, one time. Maps your top time sinks and workflows, 3-5 specific tool recommendations with pricing, prioritized implementation roadmap, estimated time savings per recommendation.
- AI Concierge: $1,500-2,000/month, no long-term contract. Two 45-minute done-with-you Zoom sessions a month, side by side with the owner, turning manual processes into Claude skills. The client owns everything; nothing runs on Cross The Bridge servers.

No long-term contracts.

## Who we work with

Owner-operated businesses in Tampa Bay and beyond:

- Home services & contractors (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping): missed-call handling, estimate follow-ups, review requests, appointment scheduling
- Legal & professional services (law firms, accountants, consultants): intake automation, client communication, document prep, scheduling
- Real estate & property (agents, property managers, investors): lead follow-up, showing coordination, tenant communication, market research
- Retail & local business (restaurants, boutiques, wellness): customer inquiries, loyalty programs, content creation, inventory management

## Results (client-reported)

- 70% reduction in time spent on reporting, quotes, and estimations
- 20 hours of owner time reclaimed per month, on average
- 14 days from first discovery call to fully operational
